plugins.name: team
plugins.description: Virtual-team operating model for Claude Code: a CTO supervises on-demand specialists (builder/reviewer/researcher), runs agile time-boxed sprints as parallel streams with serialized gates, and gates every change on top of an elevated adversarial reviewer. Project-agnostic — domain knowledge stays in per-project area skills.

plugins.name: paseo-cto
plugins.description: Dual Claude/Codex CTO plugin for a long-running Paseo engineering organization. The CTO delegates by default over a living execution plan, applies consequence-based risk review with a mandatory second look for every write, and maintains durable status, recoverable state, safe cleanup, and 15-minute fleet reconciliation.
